raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  name: pillow-avif-plugin
  source_name: pillow_avif_plugin
  version: "1.6.0"

package:
  name: ${{ name|lower }}
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://pypi.org/packages/source/${{ name[0] }}/${{ name }}/${{ source_name }}-${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 2cd412b955da5f15f951ae0aec371cec52e27f141693423e185b9af5ac3879b5

build:
  number: 2
  script: python -m pip install . -vv --no-deps --no-build-isolation

requirements:
  build:
    - ${{ compiler("c") }}
    - ${{ stdlib("c") }}
    - if: build_platform != target_platform
      then:
        - cross-python_${{ target_platform }}
        - pip
        - python
        - setuptools
  host:
    - libavif
    - pip
    - python
    - setuptools
  run:
    - pillow
    - python

tests:
  - python:
      imports:
        - pillow_avif
  - script:
      - pip check
      - python run_test.py
    files:
      recipe:
        - run_test.py
    requirements:
      run:
        - pip
        - python

about:
  homepage: https://github.com/fdintino/pillow-avif-plugin/
  repository: https://github.com/fdintino/pillow-avif-plugin/
  summary: A pillow plugin that adds avif support via libavif
  license: BSD-2-Clause
  license_file: LICENSE

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - jeongseok-meta
